name: Fabother World
description:
Fabother World is an open-source bytecode interpreter for Another World (Out of This World), the revolutionary 1991 cinematic action-adventure game designed by Éric Chahi. It executes the original game bytecode on modern hardware.

Features:
- Faithful recreation of cinematic vector animations and gameplay scenes
- Native cross-platform execution with smooth performance
- Scalable high-resolution display rendering while preserving artistic integrity
- Accurate digital sound and atmospheric musical score playback
- Uses original game data files from DOS or Amiga editions
